items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: from after i left joe nicholas band i started working with chris kelly i worked with chris kelly's band about six years

items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewer asks 'What about guys like Chris and Buddy and... would you play any second trumpet to them ever?' The interviewee responds by discussing playing with Rene and Buddy, but does not explicitly confirm playing with or knowing Chris Kelly personally, only listing him in a group of musici

ctx.x: No, no, no, no. I just picked that up mostly myself. Uh huh. Gotta go to the store and try, you know, what I imagine sounds good to me, you know. That's what I imagine.
What about Chris Kelly? Do you think he had any influence on you?

Yeah, he worked a lot of blues. I wish he was a blues man, you know. Uh huh. Do you know his blues today, any of them? Oh, it's so many. It's another thing. He played so much with himself. Careless, love, and all those other numbers like that.
